why: Both concern the same r/place spillover into a sub and often arrive in one theme, so the line between gathering posts into a megathread and objecting to them as a flood is easy to blur.

why.T3-088: Alternate accounts are treated as tile-throwing power and counted as placing capacity, placing beyond the one-pixel limit rather than working within the cooldown (T3-074) or running scripts (T3-028).

why.T3-001: Members post their own fake weather and 90-day-reporting headlines as April Fools and play along, get caught and expose the date, so this is the room's own staged fakes (T3-001), not an outside claim tested (T3-095) or an official maker's joke (T3-048).

why.T3-010: Requests, accusations and non-harm promises around the banner's edges settle lines and space with neighbours, with borders asked for, shifts offered and conditions set (T3-010), rather than a truce ending a fight (T3-149).

why.T3-015: All r/place posts are relegated to a megathread with others removed and thread merging looked into, so the canvas talk is gathered into one thread (T3-015).
why.T3-075: Members ask the room to cool it with r/place posts and call the collabs and progress updates annoying, objecting to the flood (T3-075).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-015 carries the megathread, the redirects and the merging, but not the members' own objections that r/place collabs and progress updates crowd and annoy the room, which have concepts of their own.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1182182 asks the room to cool it with r/place posts and C0349225 calls the collabs and progress updates annoying, satisfying T3-075's gate of objecting to the flood; distinct support C1182182.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-075: dropping it leaves the gathering act and loses the members' complaints.

why.T3-044: Outsiders led in by the banner identify themselves, are welcomed and taught to count, and some stay and count, so the mark is bringing visitors into the sub (T3-044), not the room's own members finding their mark (T3-082).

why.T3-028: Borrowed console code is shared, sourced and left running to automate work on the box, so scripts are run for the room's work (T3-028).
why.T3-088: Defenders are told to open incognito windows and other browsers so multiple accounts can run it, using extra accounts to place more (T3-088).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-028 carries the borrowed automation code but not the instruction to multiply it across incognito windows and other browsers so that several accounts run it, which is its own act.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0065079 tells defenders to open an incognito/private window and other browsers so multiple accounts can run the code, satisfying T3-088's gate of extra accounts; distinct support C0065079.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-088: dropping it keeps the code-sharing practice and loses only the multi-account multiplication.

why.T3-016: Members ask and answer what r/place is, how it works and where it came from, so the event is explained to newcomers (T3-016).
why.T3-070: Coordinates, a direct link and landmark directions are given so people can find the Starbound logo, sharing directions to follow (T3-070).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-016 explains the event and its rules but does not carry the coordinates, direct link and landmark route to the room's own logo, which is its own direction-giving act.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0470158 gives the direct canvas coordinates and C1496060 guides by neighbouring landmarks so members find the logo, satisfying T3-070's gate; distinct support C0470158.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-070: dropping it keeps the explanation of r/place and loses the way-finding directions.

why.T3-009: Members announce the finished logo, say 'we did it', take pride and accept that the mark lasted only a day, celebrating the finished work (T3-009).
why.T3-043: The template maker and the starter are thanked, credit is negotiated and a thread is credited for making it possible, crediting the makers (T3-043).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-009 carries the celebration and pride in the finished mark but not the thanks to the template maker and starter or the negotiation over credit among makers.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0088523 thanks a helper, C0054904 thanks the starter and disclaims credit, and C0023058 reassures about credit, satisfying T3-043's gate; distinct support C0054904.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-043: dropping it keeps the celebration and loses the credit-giving and credit dispute.

why.T3-015: All r/place posts are relegated to a megathread with others removed and thread merging looked into, so the canvas talk is gathered into one thread (T3-015).
why.T3-075: Members ask the room to cool it with r/place posts and call the collabs and progress updates annoying, objecting to the flood (T3-075).

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-015 carries the megathread, the redirects and the merging, but not the members' own objections that r/place collabs and progress updates crowd and annoy the room, which have concepts of their own.

why.T3-044: The banner's effect is measured through a record number of counters, a first-day WRC and viewer tracking on April 1, counting the newcomers the mark drew (T3-044).

why.T3-074: Counters' lag during the event, refreshing after every message and the trouble ending when r/place ended, is event trouble worked around while the work goes on (T3-074), not doubt that the room can manage (T3-136).

why.T3-095: A real policy claim is tested: suspected as a Public Health Ministry April fool, doubted but left open, and checked against social-security coverage and an earlier article, weighing an outside claim for whether it is a joke (T3-095), not a fake the room staged (T3-001).

why.T3-017: The sub's ordinary running list is updated and the updater thanked, with no canvas work and no April Fools joke as its point (T3-017).

why.T3-021: Members spot the damaged u, fix it, report it repeatedly turned into an o and keep repairing the banner, watching and repairing the work with the fixing leading rather than a fight called (T3-021).
